statement.p: Compute the curl of the vector field \vec{F} = 4y^{3}\,\mathit{\vec i}+\sin\mathopen{}\left(x\right)\,\mathit{\vec j}+\cos\mathopen{}\left(z\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}

solution.me: \mbox{curl} \vec F = \left| \begin{array}{ccc} \quad\vec i\quad \amp \quad \vec j\quad \amp \quad \vec k\quad \\ \frac{\partial}{\partial x} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial y} \amp \frac{\partial}{\partial z}\\ 4y^{3} \amp \sin\mathopen{}\left(x\right) \amp \cos\mathopen{}\left(z\right) \end{array} \right| =\left(\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(\cos\mathopen{}\left(z\right)) - \frac{\partial}{\partial z} (\sin\mathopen{}\left(x\right))\right)\vec i
